title: WEBINAR: Integrating IFRS S1 and S2 Standards in DiginexESG
summary: Diginex is a pioneering sustainability reporting technology company and advisory firm dedicated to helping organizations navigate the complexities of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) compliance and Supply chain Analysis. | Join our diginexWEBINAR as we explore the integration of IFRS S1 and S2 standards into our diginexESG framework library. Discover how these standards empower organizations to showcase their commitment to sustainability and climate responsibility. Register now for this groundbreaking event!
body_markdown:
🚀 Join our[diginexWEBINAR](https://app.getcontrast.io/register/diginex-issb-webinar?utm_source=hs_email&utm_medium=email&_hsenc=p2ANqtz-_KYysMne0VIG4E-Vhlx3NvCGrdWBB_Mvb7pDGmKmdLNiBO1k42P_v17CQ-d2XbwE8v59-5) as we unveil the integration of the IFRS S1 and S2 standards into our diginexESG framework library. This expansion solidifies our commitment to sustainable business practices worldwide.


🌍📈 The IFRS S1 and S2 standards have gained global recognition and endorsement, making them crucial for sustainable reporting. During the webinar, we will explore their impact on sustainability reporting and how they align with other frameworks in our diginexESG library.


🌱📊 By integrating the IFRS S1 and S2 standards with existing frameworks, we offer our clients a comprehensive and sophisticated platform for effective ESG reporting. Don't miss this opportunity to learn how these standards empower organizations to showcase their commitment to sustainability and climate responsibility.
